edges.reason: Understanding neural network models is necessary before learning techniques for training those models effectively.
RAG depends on retrieval concepts and mechanisms from information access before combining them with generation.
Query embedding is a retrieval-oriented technique, so core information access concepts are needed first.
Assessing retrieval quality presupposes understanding the basics of information retrieval and access systems.
RAG requires understanding generation via generative models in order to combine retrieval with generation.
